review_reply.subject: The developer replied to your review: {app}
review_reply.body: Open the app page to read the reply. You can update your review.

purchase_paid.subject: Purchase confirmed: {app}
purchase_paid.body: Payment of {amount} is confirmed. {app} is now in your library. At purchase you asked for immediate access and acknowledged that once access starts you lose the right to withdraw from the purchase of digital content (except where the law provides otherwise). Terms: Terms of Service, version {terms_version}, https://store.napsystem.com/en/legal/terms

subscription_payment_failed.subject: Subscription renewal failed
subscription_payment_failed.body: The renewal did not go through. Your paid access remains until {until}.

version_approved.subject: Version {version} of “{app}” approved
version_approved.body: The moderator approved version {version} of “{app}”. To put it in the store, open the app in the developer dashboard: set a price (if missing) and press “Publish” — or turn on “Publish right after approval”. Comment: {comment}

version_rejected.subject: Version {version} rejected
version_rejected.body: App {app}: version {version} was rejected. Moderator comment: {comment}

hw_paid.subject: Order {order} paid
hw_paid.body: Payment received. The order was handed to the supplier for picking.

hw_exception.subject: Problem with order {order}
hw_exception.body: There is a problem with your order. We will contact you to agree on a solution or a refund.

hw_shipped.subject: Order {order} shipped
hw_shipped.body: The parcel was handed to {carrier}. Tracking number: {tracking}.

hw_cancelled_refund_pending.subject: Order {order} cancelled
hw_cancelled_refund_pending.body: The order was cancelled. The refund is processed separately.

quote_ready.subject: Shipping quote for order {order}
quote_ready.body: The supplier quoted shipping at {amount}. Accept it before it expires.

return_approved.subject: Return for order {order} approved
return_approved.body: Ship the items back and enter the tracking number.

return_rejected.subject: Return for order {order} rejected
return_rejected.body: See the seller's note in the order.

return_in_transit.subject: Return for order {order} in transit
return_in_transit.body: We are waiting to receive the items.

return_received.subject: Return for order {order} received
return_received.body: The items were received and will be inspected.

return_inspected.subject: Return for order {order} inspected
return_inspected.body: Inspection finished. The refund is processed separately.

seller_new_order.subject: New order {order}
seller_new_order.body: A paid order is waiting to be picked and packed.

seller_quote_requested.subject: Shipping quote requested for {order}
seller_quote_requested.body: The buyer requested a custom shipping quote.

product_published.subject: Product {product} published
product_published.body: The moderator approved {product}: it is now in the catalog. Comment: {comment}

product_rejected.subject: Product {product} rejected
product_rejected.body: The moderator rejected {product}. Comment: {comment}. Fix the listing in the supplier dashboard and send it again.

version_published_auto.subject: App “{app}” is published
version_published_auto.body: The moderator approved version {version} of “{app}” and it was published right away — the app is in the store. Comment: {comment}

product_moderator_action.subject: Moderator: product {product} — {action}
product_moderator_action.body: A moderator performed an action on product {product}: {action}. Reason: {reason}. Details are in the supplier dashboard, Products tab.

app_moderator_action.subject: Moderator: app “{app}” — {action}
app_moderator_action.body: A moderator performed an action on the app “{app}”: {action}. Reason: {reason}. Details are in the developer dashboard.

review_moderator_action.subject: A moderator changed your review or reply
review_moderator_action.body: A moderator performed an action on your {target}: {action}. Reason: {reason}.

refund_request_approved.subject: Refund request approved
refund_request_approved.body: Your refund request for “{app}” was approved: {amount}. The money goes back to the same payment method; you will get another e-mail when the payment provider confirms it.

refund_request_rejected.subject: Refund request declined
refund_request_rejected.body: Your refund request for “{app}” was declined. Reason: {note}
